purpose: Teach: 炭素/載る/初年度/下見/即決/補っ/ルポ/用例

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 炭素中和、若い頃には聞かない言葉だった。
lines.en: Carbon-neutral—I never heard that word when I was young.
lines.style: Slow, reflective opening. Quiet observation, as if looking back across decades. Soft pause before the dash. Weight on 'never.' Trailing warmth, not wistfulness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。記事に載るたび、業界の認知、広がります。
lines.en: Yes. Every time it appears in the media, awareness across the industry spreads a little further.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Nod in the voice on 'yes.' Even pacing, building gently toward the endpoint. Conviction without pressure. Professional respect for the older man's perspective.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 初年度の数字、自信を持って公表しろ。
lines.en: Publish those first-year figures confidently. Don't hedge.
lines.style: Quiet directive, not sharp. Weight on 'confidently'—he's testing resolve, not demanding blindness. Brief, deliberate. Eyes forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 下見は、若手にも経験させます。
lines.en: We'll have the younger staff do site visits themselves. They need to see it.
lines.style: Steady commitment. Slight forward lean in the delivery. Thoughtful, not defensive—he's already decided this. Grounded, practical tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 即決の文化、若い頃から大事にしてきた。
lines.en: Making decisions quickly—I've held that dear since I was young. It matters.
lines.style: Philosophical but unsentimental. Light tap of emphasis on 'since I was young.' Slow pace. The voice of someone sharing a principle, not a memory. Grounded conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 欠員、即座に補っていく方針です。
lines.en: Whenever there's a vacancy, we fill it right away. That's our approach.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact. No apology, no explanation needed—this is how we work. Clipped efficiency in the rhythm. Brief eye contact offered in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 歴史を語るルポ、企業の財産になる。
lines.en: Stories about history—they become the company's greatest asset.
lines.style: Quiet reverence for the idea. Slow, deliberate pacing. Weight on 'greatest'—he believes this deeply. Trailing off slightly, letting the weight settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 用例、後輩にも継承させます。
lines.en: We'll make sure the younger generation learns these examples too. They'll carry it forward.
lines.style: Warm closure. Steady, slightly slower pace. Belief in continuity, not urgency. Soft on 'younger generation'—almost parental. Gentle conviction that the work continues.
